verdict.rationale: Dagster models dbt transformations as assets with explicit upstream dependencies, and Declarative Automation/sensors can trigger runs based on the state of upstream data assets rather than a fixed schedule, directly enabling dbt runs to fire when fresh data lands. Asset checks can even verify data freshness as part of the pipeline. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of this dbt-freshness-triggering pattern in production (only first-party docs cited).
